chunks: Aḥmad ibn Idrīs, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd al-Jabbār, from Ṣafwān ibn Yaḥyā, from Ibn Abī ʿUthmān, from al-Muʿallā ibn Khunays, from Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
Indeed, the Imam knows the Imam who will come after him, so he bequeaths to him.

key_terms.إِلَيْهِ: to him, i.e., to the succeeding Imam
key_terms.الَّذِي: the one who is specifically intended
key_terms.فَيُوصِي: then he bequeaths or entrusts authority

ai.seo_question: How does an Imam know who the next Imam is after him?
ai.summary: This hadith states that each Imam knows the Imam who will succeed him and entrusts the Imamate to him. It indicates that succession in the Imamate is designated and transmitted with certainty, not left unknown or arbitrary.
